text: You're looking for a quick and flavorful dish that fits within your 45-minute time frame and aligns with your goal of lowering sodium intake. The Better Frizzled Cabbage recipe checks all these boxes. With a ready time of just 20 minutes, you can whip up this delicious and healthy side dish in no time.
